title: pdstack project config
description: The project config at .agents/pdstack.json. Every key is optional. An absent key takes its default.

worktreeHome.description: The folder where the project keeps its worktrees, relative to the repo root. Default: ../<repo>-worktrees.

stackPacks.description: The stack packs that the project selects. Default: [].

planPath.description: The folder where multi-phase-plan writes the plan. Default: ~/.claude/orchestrate/<slug>/docs/.

forensicsDir.description: The folder where the forensics playbooks write captured files. Default: $TMPDIR/pdstack/<repo>/<timestamp>/.
